choices.explanation: S3 Transfer Acceleration uses AWS edge locations to accelerate uploads into a single S3 bucket from globally distributed sites. Multipart upload is appropriate for very large objects and keeps the design operationally simple.
Amazon Athena queries data directly in S3 with standard SQL and is serverless, so it requires the least architectural change and operational overhead for simple on-demand queries.

choices.solution: Add the aws:PrincipalOrgID global condition key with a reference to the organization ID to the S3 bucket policy.

choices.explanation: AWS Snowball Edge is designed for offline bulk transfer of tens of terabytes. It moves the 70 TB without consuming the company's network bandwidth, which directly satisfies the requirement to use the least possible network bandwidth. Historical-service limitation: Snowball Edge is available only to eligible existing customers since November 7, 2025; new customers need a current physical-transfer or online-transfer alternative.

choices.solution: Publish the messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) subscriptions. Configure the consumer applications to process the messages from the queues.
choices.explanation: SNS fans out messages to independent SQS standard queues, decoupling each consumer and buffering bursts. Standard SQS queues support nearly unlimited API throughput. SNS publish quotas are Regional, so provision sufficient throughput and make consumers idempotent.
A FIFO queue preserves order within each message group. A Lambda event source mapping polls the queue and processes each group in order; use one group if strict order across all orders is required.
S3 object-created notifications put image-processing jobs into a durable SQS queue, decoupling uploads from processing.

choices.solution: Configure an SQS event source mapping for the Lambda function. Allow Lambda to delete messages from the queue after successful processing.
choices.explanation: A Lambda event source mapping polls SQS, invokes the function, and deletes messages after successful processing. Failed messages become visible again; processing must be idempotent.

Gateway Load Balancer is purpose-built for inserting and scaling third-party virtual network appliances such as firewalls. A GWLB endpoint transparently steers application traffic to the inspection VPC before it reaches the web servers.

EBS Fast Snapshot Restore creates volumes from snapshots that are fully initialized at creation, eliminating first-read latency and immediately delivering provisioned performance. That directly matches the need to clone data quickly while keeping production and test volumes independent.

Cost Explorer filters historical costs by service, instance type, and usage type to identify the effect of larger EC2 instances. Use CloudTrail to identify who changed an instance type; cost data alone does not identify the actor.

RDS automatically restarts a stopped instance after seven days, so stopping alone does not avoid compute charges for the entire month. Keep a manual snapshot, delete the instance after testing, and restore it before the next run. Snapshot storage and restore time still apply.

Kinesis Data Streams durably ingests high-volume transactions and allows independent consumers. Lambda transforms records and writes sanitized data to DynamoDB. Downstream applications must consume sanitized output if they are not authorized to see the original sensitive stream.
Versioning preserves earlier object versions so accidental overwrites or deletions can be recovered.
MFA Delete requires MFA for permanent deletion of object versions or changes to the versioning state. Ordinary deletes can still create delete markers.
An SQS subscription buffers SNS notifications durably while the downstream system is unavailable.
A Lambda event source mapping processes queued notifications and retries failures, decoupling ingestion from delivery.

choices.solution: Create separate On-Demand Capacity Reservations in each of the three required Availability Zones in the specified Region.
choices.explanation: An On-Demand Capacity Reservation reserves matching EC2 capacity in one Availability Zone. Create one in each required zone and retain it for the event; a single reservation cannot span three zones.

choices.solution: Store individual files in S3 Intelligent-Tiering and catalog supported transcript formats for Amazon Athena. Transition them to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year. Restore archived files to S3 before querying or retrieving them.
choices.explanation: Intelligent-Tiering suits changing access patterns during the first year. Athena can query supported formats in accessible S3 storage, but it cannot query objects still archived in Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Restore archived objects before querying; Glacier Select refers to the separate legacy vault service, not S3 Glacier storage-class objects.
SES delivers the report by email; the application or Lambda function prepares the report content.
An EventBridge schedule invokes Lambda to query the application API and generate the report without maintaining a scheduler server.
Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling replaces failed instances and adjusts capacity. EFS supplies shared file storage that remains accessible to instances in different Availability Zones.
Deep Archive reduces long-term storage costs after the first year. Object Lock compliance mode protects each retained version for ten years even against privileged deletion.
FSx for Windows File Server provides managed SMB shares and Active Directory integration. A Multi-AZ file system provides a standby and automatic failover.
A database security group can reference the application instances' security group so only that tier can establish database connections.
Rekognition moderation detects potentially inappropriate image or video content. Route uncertain results for human review rather than assuming every low-confidence detection is definitive.
Fargate runs ECS containers without provisioning or patching EC2 hosts, reducing operational work while preserving the container packaging.

Kinesis Data Streams handles ingestion, Firehose buffers and delivers data to S3, and Redshift provides warehouse analytics. Firehose delivery is near-real-time rather than immediate per-record delivery.
An ALB HTTP listener can redirect requests to an HTTPS listener without changing the application servers. Configure a valid certificate on the HTTPS listener.
Secrets Manager securely stores and rotates database credentials. The EC2 instance role grants the application access without embedding long-lived AWS credentials.

Import the third-party certificate into ACM and attach it to the ALB. Imported certificates are not automatically renewed by ACM; monitor approaching expiration with EventBridge and replace them manually.
S3 object-created notifications invoke Lambda promptly. Lambda converts the PDF and writes the JPEG back to S3; filter prefixes or suffixes to avoid recursively triggering on its own outputs.

FSx for Windows File Server provides cloud SMB storage, and FSx File Gateway historically provided local caching for on-premises clients. FSx File Gateway has been unavailable to new customers since October 28, 2024; this choice applies only to eligible existing customers.
Textract extracts text from scanned documents and Comprehend Medical detects medical entities and protected health information in that text.
S3 Lifecycle moves eligible objects to Standard-IA after its 30-day minimum age and expires them after the required four-year retention period.

Extend message visibility while processing and delete the message only after success. This prevents a long-running task from making the message visible too early, but standard SQS queues still provide at-least-once delivery; consumers must be idempotent.
Direct Connect provides the primary dedicated path with consistent network performance. A Site-to-Site VPN supplies a cheaper backup path over the internet if that connection fails.

A Multi-AZ application group and Aurora Replica in another zone provide failover at both tiers. RDS Proxy pools connections and helps applications reconnect during database failover; it does not replace database redundancy.

An ALB supports HTTP-aware health checks and removes unhealthy targets from routing. Enable Elastic Load Balancing health checks on the Auto Scaling group so unhealthy instances are also replaced. NLBs can support HTTP health checks too, so an NLB is not intrinsically unable to detect HTTP failures.

DynamoDB point-in-time recovery restores a new table to a selected time within its configured recovery window, with second-level recovery points. Restore duration depends on table size and indexes, so a one-hour RTO must be tested rather than assumed.
An S3 gateway endpoint avoids NAT processing charges for same-Region S3 access. An endpoint policy limits allowed API access but does not itself grant permissions.
Allow inbound SSH to the public bastion only from the company's external IP range.
Allow inbound SSH to private application instances only from the bastion's private IP address. A security-group reference is also suitable where supported.
Allow public HTTPS on TCP port 443 to the web servers.
Allow SQL Server traffic on TCP port 1433 to the database only from instances associated with the web tier security group.
API Gateway and Lambda provide managed API processing, while SQS durably buffers inter-service work so an overloaded consumer does not cause dropped transactions.
DataSync automates validated, encrypted data transfer, while Direct Connect provides a dedicated network path. Direct Connect alone does not encrypt traffic, but DataSync uses TLS.
API Gateway sends records to Kinesis Data Streams. Firehose invokes Lambda transformations and delivers buffered output to S3 with managed retries and scaling.
AWS Backup schedules DynamoDB recovery points and applies seven-year retention, avoiding custom backup scripts. Backup retention does not itself delete live items from the table.
DynamoDB on-demand capacity bills for actual read and write requests and handles variable traffic without maintaining provisioned capacity during idle periods.
Share the AMI launch permission only with the partner account and authorize that account to use the customer managed KMS key protecting the EBS snapshots.

SQS retains pending jobs independently of the worker fleet. Auto Scaling adds and removes stateless workers as backlog changes; backlog per instance is preferable to raw queue depth for target tracking.
CloudFront supports an HTTPS custom origin on premises, serving content from edge locations while keeping the backend in the United States.
Reserved Instances discount the steady production baseline. On-Demand instances can be stopped outside development and testing hours without a long-term usage commitment.

S3 Object Lock protects object versions against permanent deletion and alteration during retention. Use compliance mode for non-bypassable regulatory retention and apply the required retention period.
Secrets Manager stores the database credentials and supports automatic rotation. Authorize the web-server role to retrieve only the required secret and configure rotation explicitly.
SQS retains customer events while the database is unavailable. A separate Lambda consumer retries database writes after upgrades; make writes idempotent because messages may be delivered again.
With Requester Pays, the requesting AWS account pays the request and data-download costs instead. The original company still pays for storing the 3 TB in S3.
Versioning preserves previous audit-document versions. MFA Delete protects permanent version deletions and changes to versioning state; it does not require MFA for every ordinary delete request.
A read replica moves the reporting script's read workload off the primary instance. It is asynchronous, so allow for replica lag in the report.
An S3 gateway endpoint creates a VPC route to S3 over the AWS network without an internet gateway or NAT device.
An S3 gateway endpoint provides a private route from the VPC to S3 without a NAT gateway.
A bucket policy limits authorization to the application role and, where required, the specified VPC endpoint; network connectivity alone does not grant access.
Aurora replicas handle read workloads, and Aurora cloning initially shares storage pages through copy-on-write. The staging clone remains independent without waiting for a full logical export.

S3 events enqueue work in SQS and Lambda scales processing with demand without managing workers. DynamoDB stores the transformed JSON as document data; use S3 instead if a literal JSON file object is required.
Read replicas offload eligible reads from the writer. The application must route reads to the replica endpoints and tolerate asynchronous replication lag.

The Allow applies only to TerminateInstances requests whose source IP is within 10.100.100.0/24. The explicit Deny blocks EC2 actions outside us-east-1. Therefore a request from 10.100.100.254 in us-east-1 can terminate an instance.
FSx for Windows File Server provides managed Windows SMB storage with Active Directory authentication; choose Multi-AZ for the required high availability.

choices.solution: Set the SQS visibility timeout to at least six times the Lambda function timeout, plus the maximum batching window. Make the function idempotent to tolerate redelivery.
choices.explanation: A sufficient visibility timeout prevents messages from reappearing while the first Lambda invocation is still running or retrying. AWS recommends at least six times the function timeout plus the batching window. SQS and Lambda still allow duplicate delivery, so email processing must be idempotent.
FSx for Lustre provides a managed Lustre file system accessible to supported clients over private network connectivity from on premises.
A NAT gateway in each public subnet provides IPv4 internet egress for private instances. Route each zone's private subnet through its local NAT gateway to avoid a cross-zone dependency.
An on-premises DataSync agent reads the existing NFS file system and transfers its data to EFS.

choices.solution: Use AWS DataSync to configure the on-premises NFS file system behind the SFTP server as the source location and Amazon EFS as the destination location.
choices.explanation: Configure an NFS source location for the storage behind the SFTP server and an EFS destination. DataSync does not use SFTP as a source protocol.
Glue job bookmarks track previously processed input so later runs process new or changed data rather than repeating all prior work. Use a supported input format and stable transformation context.
Shield Advanced adds enhanced DDoS protection and response support for eligible protected resources.
CloudFront distributes static and dynamic HTTP content through edge locations, helping absorb attacks and reduce load on the origin.
EventBridge invokes Lambda through a resource-based function permission for events.amazonaws.com and lambda:InvokeFunction. Scope the permission to the specific rule ARN for least privilege.
SSE-KMS provides encryption at rest and CloudTrail audit events for KMS usage. A customer managed symmetric KMS key supports automatic annual rotation.

API Gateway exposes a REST API and Lambda implements reads and writes to the location data store. Kinesis analytics processes streams but is not a REST-accessible record store; add the required persistent data store to the implementation.

choices.solution: After an automobile sale is committed, have the application publish the sale event to an Amazon SNS topic. Fan out the topic to a separate SQS queue for each target system, and use Lambda consumers to update the targets.
choices.explanation: SNS fan-out with separate SQS queues gives each target an independent durable copy of the sale event. RDS service event notifications report database operational events, not row changes. Publish from the application after commit, preferably through a transactional outbox for reliable delivery.

A legal hold protects object versions indefinitely until an authorized user removes it. Removing a hold requires s3:PutObjectLegalHold, and permanent deletion also requires the relevant object-version deletion permission.
Presigned URLs let browsers upload original images directly to S3, removing upload traffic from the web servers.
S3 object-created notifications invoke Lambda to resize images asynchronously, removing image processing from the upload request.
Amazon MQ active/standby ActiveMQ brokers, a Multi-AZ consumer Auto Scaling group, and RDS MySQL Multi-AZ remove the single-instance dependencies while keeping infrastructure managed.
ECS on Fargate runs the existing containers without host administration. ECS Service Auto Scaling adjusts tasks and the ALB distributes incoming requests.

Shipping the bulk data avoids the exhausted network connection. Glue supplies managed transformation after import. Snowball Edge is now restricted to eligible existing customers; a new customer needs another physical-transfer option.

114.question: A company has created an image analysis application in which users can upload photos and add photo frames to their images. The users upload images and metadata to indicate which photo frames they want to add to their images. The application uses a single Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon DynamoDB to store the metadata. The application is becoming more popular, and the number of users is increasing. The company expects the number of concurrent users to vary significantly depending on the time of day and day of week. The company must ensure that the application can scale to meet the needs of the growing user base. Which solution meets these requirements?

choices.explanation: S3 is durable object storage for images, DynamoDB stores metadata, and Lambda scales image processing without maintaining application instances.
Private instances use an S3 VPC endpoint for S3 traffic without internet routing. A gateway endpoint is sufficient for same-Region access from the VPC.

116.question: A company uses a popular content management system (CMS) for its corporate website. However, the required patching and maintenance are burdensome. The company is redesigning its website and wants a new solution. The website will be updated four times a year and does not need to have any dynamic content available. The solution must provide high scalability and enhanced security. Which combination of changes will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

choices.explanation: CloudFront provides HTTPS delivery for the static website. S3 website endpoints themselves support only HTTP.
S3 static website hosting serves HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and images without server patching or instance management.
S3 scales object storage independently of the application instances and stores a large document repository without provisioning file-system or block-volume capacity.
Firewall Manager centrally applies WAF policies across organization accounts and Regions. WAF filters SQL injection and cross-site scripting against the Regional API stages.

choices.solution: Set up AWS Shield in both Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.

choices.explanation: Encryption cannot be enabled in place on an unencrypted RDS instance. Copy its snapshot with encryption enabled and restore a replacement instance; subsequent snapshots inherit encryption.
KMS manages encryption-key storage, permissions, and cryptographic operations without a custom key-management server fleet.
An ALB HTTPS listener uses the imported ACM certificate to terminate TLS, moving handshake and encryption overhead away from the application instances.
Spot Instances reduce cost for stateless jobs that tolerate interruption. Save checkpoints or retry work so an interruption does not prevent completion.
Private application instances behind the load balancer and a Multi-AZ RDS deployment provide application and database availability.
An internet-facing ALB uses public subnets in two Availability Zones. A NAT gateway in each zone gives private application instances resilient outbound access to the payment service.
Keep the recent two years in an immediately retrievable storage class and transition older objects to Deep Archive for lower long-term storage cost.

Local instance-store storage suits high-I/O temporary video processing; select instances with at least the required local capacity. Use S3 for durable media and S3 Glacier storage classes for archives. Instance-store data is ephemeral, so durable inputs and outputs must be stored elsewhere.
An EKS managed node group manages Kubernetes worker lifecycle; Spot reduces cost for stateless, interruption-tolerant workloads. Use diverse instance types and handle interruptions.
Aurora PostgreSQL provides a managed PostgreSQL-compatible database with replication and failover, reducing database administration.
ECS on Fargate runs and scales the existing Linux containers without managing EC2 hosts.

130.question: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. The application performs best when the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances is at or near 40%. What should a solutions architect do to maintain the desired performance across all instances in the group?

choices.explanation: A target tracking policy scales the EC2 group to maintain the specified CPU target, rather than using fixed capacity or a schedule for changing demand.
An OAI authorizes CloudFront to read a private S3 REST origin while direct anonymous S3 requests remain denied. Origin access control is the recommended modern approach for new distributions.
S3 stores the downloadable reports and CloudFront caches them near users globally, reducing origin load and latency without maintaining web servers.
RDS Custom for Oracle allows supported operating-system and database customization. A cross-Region replica provides a recovery option with less administration than self-managed EC2 replication.

134.question: A company wants to move its application to a serverless solution. The serverless solution needs to analyze existing and new data by using SQL. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data requires encryption and must be replicated to a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices.solution: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
choices.explanation: Athena queries data in S3 without database servers. Configure S3 replication permissions and destination encryption for SSE-KMS objects; existing objects need Batch Replication or a deliberate initial load. S3 treats multi-Region KMS keys as regional keys rather than automatically reusing ciphertext.

135.question: A company runs workloads on AWS. The company needs to connect to a service from an external provider. The service is hosted in the provider's VPC. According to the company's security team, the connectivity must be private and must be restricted to the target service. The connection must be initiated only from the company's VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.solution: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet of the company's VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target service.
Ask the provider to create a VPC endpoint service for the target service. Create an interface VPC endpoint in the company's VPC and use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the service.
choices.explanation: The provider publishes an endpoint service, and the consumer creates an interface endpoint. PrivateLink exposes only the designated service without opening general VPC-to-VPC connectivity.
A full-load and ongoing change-data-capture task keeps Aurora synchronized while the source database remains online.
A DMS replication instance connects to the source and target and performs the migration task.

138.question: A company runs its ecommerce application on AWS. Every new order is published as a message in a RabbitMQ queue that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a single Availability Zone. These messages are processed by a different application that runs on a separate EC2 instance. This application stores the details in a PostgreSQL database on another EC2 instance. All the EC2 instances are in the same Availability Zone. The company needs to redesign its architecture to provide the highest availability with the least operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

choices.solution: Migrate the RabbitMQ queue to an Amazon MQ cluster deployment across three Availability Zones. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for the application. Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL with Multi-AZ enabled.
choices.explanation: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ uses a three-node Multi-AZ cluster for high availability, rather than the active/standby pair used for ActiveMQ. Multi-AZ application instances and RDS remove the remaining single-zone dependencies.
Spot capacity reduces costs for the interruption-tolerant ingestion layer; jobs must handle interruption and retries.
Compute Savings Plans cover predictable eligible EC2, Fargate, and Lambda usage under an hourly spending commitment.

CloudFront delivers static and dynamic HTTPS content through nearby edge locations and optimized origin connections. Use the ALB as the origin and configure cache policies so personalized responses are not shared between users.
Global Accelerator supports UDP, static entry IPs, and regional failover. NLB distributes UDP traffic to EC2 instances that can run the modified Linux kernel.
ECS manages independently deployable container services, and ALB listener rules route requests to their target groups. Use Fargate if avoiding host management is required.

144.question: A company recently started using Amazon Aurora as the data store for its global ecommerce application. When large reports are run, developers report that the ecommerce application is performing poorly. After reviewing metrics in Amazon CloudWatch, a solutions architect finds that the ReadIOPS and CPUUtilization metrics are spiking when monthly reports run. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

choices.explanation: An Aurora Replica serves the reporting queries separately from the writer, reducing CPU and read load on the instance processing ecommerce transactions.

Reservations discount steady baseline usage and Spot lowers the cost of additional stateless capacity. Maintain sufficient reliable baseline capacity and handle Spot interruptions to preserve availability.
Keep recent logs in S3 for troubleshooting and transition older logs to Deep Archive for lower long-term storage cost when restore delays are acceptable.

An SQS on-failure destination retains failed asynchronous Lambda invocation records after retries are exhausted. A replay consumer can retry them later; it must understand the destination record's envelope.
SQS FIFO preserves order within a message group and integrates with Lambda for managed processing. Configure message groups and idempotent processing to match the required ordering.

A CloudWatch composite alarm combines child alarm states with a Boolean rule, allowing notification only when CPU and memory conditions occur together. Memory metrics require an agent or custom publishing.
Control Tower preventive controls can restrict allowed Regions and prohibit internet connectivity in governed accounts. Exempt global services where the Region restriction requires it.
Organizations SCPs can deny internet-gateway operations and regional actions outside the approved Region across member accounts.
EventBridge schedules Lambda calls to stop and start the RDS instance during predictable idle periods. Stopped instances still incur storage charges and restart automatically after seven days.

choices.solution: Configure S3 inventory to manage objects and move them to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 90 days.
Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy that moves the objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 90 days.
choices.explanation: A lifecycle transition after 90 days reduces storage cost for rarely accessed older files while Standard serves the frequently accessed recent files.

Object Lock compliance retention prevents permanent deletion or alteration of protected versions for the configured year, including by administrators. Restrict write permissions separately if users must not create additional versions.
CloudFront caches S3 content at edge locations close to viewers, providing global delivery with reduced origin traffic.
Athena queries the staged S3 data on demand, and QuickSight presents the results as dashboards without a dedicated warehouse.
Lake Formation blueprints generate Glue workflows to ingest database data into S3. Glue processes and catalogs data in Parquet format for efficient analytics.
Enable database audit logging and export the PostgreSQL logs to CloudWatch Logs. Set the log group retention to never expire; exporting logs alone does not enable auditing.
AWS Backup schedules Aurora backups and applies a five-year retention policy. Automated Aurora backup retention alone is limited to 35 days.

CloudFront is the CDN in these choices and can accelerate both live HTTP-based streaming and video-on-demand for a global audience. Global Accelerator improves network paths to regional endpoints but is not a CDN/cache for this use case.
IAM authorization and per-user roles authenticate API callers and enforce permissions before the Lambda integration runs.
A WAF web ACL on the REST API stage blocks matching malicious requests and can rate-limit bot traffic before it reaches Lambda.

S3 Standard is durable, low-cost object storage with millisecond access. Glacier does not meet the millisecond-access requirement, while OpenSearch and RDS are unnecessarily expensive for a 300 MB backup.
S3 events trigger managed Lambda document processing and Aurora stores results in a managed relational database. Size and configure the Lambda workload within its execution limits.
FSx for Lustre supplies high-performance shared storage and can import and export data through linked S3 storage for persistent inputs and outputs.
ECR stores the container images, and ECS on Fargate runs them without host management. A Multi-AZ service and target tracking adjust capacity as demand changes.

SQS buffers messages durably and a dead-letter queue isolates repeated failures. Set message retention longer than the two-day backlog. A single SQS visibility timeout is limited to 12 hours, so a two-day uninterrupted processing task needs checkpoints or a different orchestration design.
WAF inspects requests at CloudFront, while a private S3 REST origin accessible only through CloudFront prevents direct S3 access from bypassing inspection. OAC is preferred for new distributions.
CloudFront caches popular images from the S3 origin at global edge locations, reducing latency and repeated origin requests.
Reserved capacity serves the reliable baseline and Spot workers process additional durable SQS backlog at lower cost. Consumers must handle interruptions and redelivery.
An Organizations SCP sets centrally managed maximum permissions across member accounts. It does not grant permissions, and it does not restrict the management account.
Shield Advanced provides enhanced DDoS protection for eligible ALB resources and access to additional detection and response capabilities.
A WAF geo-match rule on the ALB can allow the permitted country and block other source-IP geolocations. IP geolocation is not proof of a user's citizenship or physical location.
API Gateway exposes the REST API and Lambda scales the tax calculation code with demand, reducing idle server costs outside seasonal peaks.
CloudFront caches media at nearby edge locations and serves repeated requests without repeatedly retrieving the same objects from the S3 origin.
An Auto Scaling group spanning two Availability Zones retains application capacity if one zone becomes unavailable. The load balancer distributes traffic to healthy instances.
RDS Proxy pools and reuses database connections, reducing connection churn from concurrent Lambda invocations. It does not increase the database's underlying query-processing capacity.
A DynamoDB gateway endpoint routes table calls privately without NAT or internet egress. IAM and endpoint policies still control authorization.

DAX supplies an API-compatible cache for eventually consistent DynamoDB reads, reducing read latency and table load. Strongly consistent reads bypass the cache, and applications need a DAX-compatible client.
AWS Backup can centrally back up both EC2/EBS and RDS resources and copy recovery points across Regions. That is less operational work than managing separate snapshot and replication mechanisms.

Attach an IAM role to the EC2 instance that permits reading the SecureString parameter and decrypting it with the KMS key. IAM policies are attached to identities/roles, not directly to an EC2 instance.
Shield Advanced protects eligible NLB resources against sophisticated network and transport layer DDoS attacks.
WAF on the API Gateway REST API stage filters application-layer exploits such as SQL injection.
SQS decouples producers from consumers and durably holds work when a consumer is slow or unavailable. Consumers acknowledge successfully processed messages by deleting them.
An RDS MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance synchronously replicates to a standby in another Availability Zone and provides managed failover.
S3 and CloudFront serve static content, API Gateway and Lambda implement the dynamic API, and DynamoDB on-demand handles changing request rates without provisioned-capacity administration.
A Lambda function must be configured for VPC access so its ENIs can use the VPC routing to the virtual private gateway and existing Direct Connect path. No additional VPN or public IP is required.
The ECS task role, configured as taskRoleArn, gives the code in the container its S3 permissions. The execution role is used by ECS to start and manage the task.
RDS Multi-AZ provides a managed standby and automatic database failover.
An ECS service on Fargate runs containers without host maintenance; use tasks in multiple Availability Zones and service scaling for availability.
Object Lock compliance retention prevents permanent deletion or alteration of protected versions for the required retention period, including by the root user.
SSE-KMS with a customer managed symmetric key and automatic annual rotation encrypts documents at rest while retaining older key material for decryption.
Move reporting reads to an RDS read replica so analytical queries no longer compete with order-processing traffic on the primary database.
Store the extracted structured medical data in S3 and query it with Athena.
S3 events invoke Lambda; Textract extracts document text and Comprehend Medical identifies medical entities and protected health information.
ElastiCache for Redis can cache frequently read database data and supports replication/Multi-AZ high availability. Memcached does not provide the same HA capabilities.

Two database EC2 instances in different Availability Zones with database-level replication and clustering provide redundancy and automatic failover. A single instance with recovery or AMI-based replacement is not highly available.
SQS provides durable buffering between order submission and EC2 workers. If workers fail, messages remain available for retry, preventing users from having to resubmit orders.

DynamoDB TTL is purpose-built for automatic expiry. Store an expiration timestamp on each item and configure that attribute as the table TTL to remove data older than 30 days with minimal operational effort.
A load-balanced, Multi-AZ Elastic Beanstalk environment runs the existing .NET application with managed deployment and scaling.
DMS migrates the Oracle data to RDS for Oracle; a Multi-AZ RDS deployment provides managed database failover.

EKS preserves the Kubernetes deployment model, Fargate removes worker-node management, and DocumentDB provides MongoDB-compatible APIs. This combination minimizes code, deployment, and infrastructure changes.
Amazon Transcribe provides speaker diarization and transcription. Athena can query transcript files stored in S3, where lifecycle/retention policies can satisfy the seven-year retention requirement.
API Gateway has a managed Amazon Cognito user-pool authorizer. It validates Cognito tokens without custom Lambda authorization logic, minimizing operational overhead.

SQS buffers incoming requests so temporary DynamoDB write-capacity pressure does not lose requests. Lambda can drain the queue at a sustainable rate. DAX is primarily a read cache and API Gateway throttling would reject requests rather than preserve them.

An S3 interface endpoint provides private IP connectivity, and the bucket policy limits access to the instance role. A gateway endpoint is also valid with route tables, but it has no security groups and is not scoped to one Availability Zone as the other choice claims.
SQS durably buffers orders and decouples collection from fulfillment. Scale each consumer Auto Scaling group on backlog per instance to match available workers to its queue.

A company experienced a breach that affected several applications in its on-premises data center. The attacker took advantage of vulnerabilities in the custom applications that were running on the servers. The company is now migrating its applications to run on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to implement a solution that actively scans for vulnerabilities on the EC2 instances and sends a report that details the findings. Which solution will meet these requirements? Historical-service limitation: Snowball Edge is available only to eligible existing customers since November 7, 2025; new customers need a current physical-transfer or online-transfer alternative.

A pilot-light recovery design keeps replicated data and the necessary infrastructure ready in another Region. Route 53 failover switches traffic after database promotion and application capacity are ready; validate recovery within 30 minutes.
A stateful security group allows inbound HTTPS on port 443 and automatically allows the corresponding response traffic.
A stateless network ACL must allow inbound port 443 and outbound client ephemeral ports. Use the client port range specified by the question; some clients require 1024-65535.
R is memory optimized, extra metrics are required for memory
An IAM role for the pod, through IRSA or EKS Pod Identity, grants least-privilege DynamoDB access without embedding credentials.
A DynamoDB gateway endpoint routes calls privately within the AWS network without a NAT gateway.
Route 53 multivalue answer routing returns healthy records when associated health checks are configured; it is not a full load balancer.
Running two instances in each of two Availability Zones preserves capacity if a zone fails.
Glue transforms the raw data stored in S3 and catalogs the processed data for analytics.
API Gateway ingests device requests into Kinesis Data Streams; Firehose delivers the stream to S3 without managing ingestion servers.

Flow logs, metric filters, and alarms detect accepted flows on SSH or RDP ports and notify operations. They do not prove successful authentication; collect host authentication logs if actual logins must be detected.
A strong, unique root password reduces the risk of credential compromise. Avoid routine root-user use.
MFA adds a separate authentication factor to protect the root user even if its password is compromised.

Oracle-to-Aurora PostgreSQL is heterogeneous, so use AWS Schema Conversion Tool for schema conversion and AWS DMS with full load plus CDC to keep source and target synchronized while applications migrate gradually. A memory-optimized replication instance is appropriate for a high read/write workload.

choices.solution: Create public subnets in at least two Availability Zones and associate them with the internet-facing ALB. Add an internet-gateway route to the public-subnet route tables. Allow the ALB to reach the private instances through security-group rules.

Completing long transactions reduces replication lag and the time needed for the initial read replica to catch up.
RDS requires automated backups with a nonzero retention period before a read replica can be created.
EFS provides elastic shared file storage mountable by multiple EC2 instances. Regional EFS replicates data across Availability Zones for redundancy.
Policy1 allows all EC2 actions, including ec2:TerminateInstances. Policy2 explicitly denies Directory Service deletion. Neither policy allows deleting IAM users or CloudWatch log data.

choices.solution: Use a stable checkout idempotency key to create or retrieve one database order. Send its order number to an SQS FIFO queue using that key for deduplication. Process the payment idempotently, then delete the message after success.
choices.explanation: SQS FIFO can deduplicate repeated message submissions and order payment processing, but it cannot prevent the checkout code from creating a new database order on every retry. Use a stable idempotency key for order creation, message deduplication, and payment processing.
Versioning preserves prior document versions and allows recovery after an overwrite or ordinary delete.
MFA Delete protects permanent version deletion and changes to the versioning state, while ordinary uploads and delete markers remain possible.

choices.solution: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle status events and route the events to Amazon Data Firehose for delivery to Amazon S3. Do not use lifecycle hooks that pause instance launches.

CloudFront caches distinct representations when the cache policy includes the relevant device-dependent key.
Lambda@Edge examines the User-Agent and selects the appropriate object. Configure the cache key to avoid serving one device's representation to another.
An ECS cluster provides the logical environment for managing container tasks and services.
A Fargate service with at least two tasks across Availability Zones provides managed compute, task replacement, and service scaling without EC2 host management.

choices.solution: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink application to analyze the data.

The stated bottleneck is database read performance. ElastiCache reduces repeated reads and latency. RDS Proxy addresses connection pooling and connection storms, not a read-I/O bottleneck.

Encrypt data in the client before sending it to S3 and use HTTPS for transport. Server-side encryption occurs only after S3 receives the data, so it does not satisfy encryption-before-upload by itself.
CloudFront fronts the ALB and optimizes delivery globally. Including Accept-Language in the cache key prevents mixing language-specific cached responses.

A scheduled action increases desired capacity before the office opens, avoiding a delay while reactive scaling detects the morning load. Keep dynamic scaling enabled and allow capacity to decrease later.
RDS storage autoscaling increases allocated storage when capacity becomes low, within a configured maximum. It does not scale database CPU or read throughput.
CPU-based EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts the application instance count to match variable application load.
DynamoDB stores the hierarchical records; a monthly export to S3 makes the data available for sensitive-data inspection. Table exports require point-in-time recovery.
Macie inspects the S3 export for sensitive financial information. Schedule monthly discovery and use EventBridge and SNS for notifications; Macie does not inspect DynamoDB directly.
FSx for NetApp ONTAP exposes the same data through NFS and SMB, allowing Linux simulations and Windows visualization to share storage without application code changes.

Cost Explorer can report costs grouped by activated cost allocation tags, but AWS billing does not automatically attribute costs to IAM users. This answer requires resources to have an activated user or department tag; without attribution metadata the question is underspecified.
CloudFront signed cookies authorize restricted content without changing existing URLs, which supports users with hardcoded URLs.
CloudFront signed URLs authorize individual objects for clients that cannot use cookies.

choices.solution: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the data. Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to transform the data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to write the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the transformed data from Amazon S3.
choices.explanation: Kinesis Data Streams ingests data; Managed Service for Apache Flink transforms it; Firehose stores output in S3 and Athena queries the stored data.
MSK ingests Kafka messages and Glue streaming ETL transforms them into S3; Athena queries the resulting data.
Stored Volume Gateway retains the complete dataset locally and uploads asynchronous EBS snapshot backups to AWS, preserving local access while automating cloud backup.

Each subnet belongs to one Availability Zone. Distribute the application instances across two zones and enable RDS Multi-AZ; adding database network connections alone does not create a standby.
CloudFront caches and delivers video through nearby edge locations, reducing origin load and download latency.

choices.solution: Use AWS Elemental MediaConvert to convert video files into appropriate encodings and adaptive streaming formats.
choices.explanation: MediaConvert creates device-appropriate video encodings and streaming renditions. Elastic Transcoder is a retired service.
Use the payer account to obtain organization-wide RDS reservation purchase recommendations based on consolidated usage.
The RDS reservation purchase recommendation check identifies potential savings for sustained On-Demand database usage; an idle-instance check addresses a different issue.

An SNS topic fans out requests to durable SQS queues. Subscription filters route each quote type to its appropriate queue, and independent consumers process requests without maintaining stream shards.

Inspector scans EC2 software inventory for vulnerabilities and produces findings. Current scanning uses SSM-managed agents or eligible EBS snapshot-based agentless scanning; it does not require the old Inspector Classic agent.
choices.solution: Enable Amazon Inspector EC2 vulnerability scanning. Configure supported agent-based scanning with Systems Manager or eligible agentless scanning, and use Lambda to generate and distribute findings reports.

choices.explanation: A scheduled Glue ETL job transforms the CSV inputs and loads Redshift without maintaining a custom processing server.
CloudTrail records AWS API activity for auditing, including who made an API call and when.
Config records supported resource configurations and evaluates rules to detect noncompliance and configuration changes.

choices.solution: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink to query the data.
choices.explanation: Kinesis Data Streams durably ingests the data, and Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink provides managed stream processing. Use Firehose where the design requires delivery to S3. The former Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL service was discontinued in January 2026.

To enforce server-side encryption on uploads, the bucket policy can deny PutObject requests that do not include the x-amz-server-side-encryption header (or otherwise fail the required encryption condition). ACL and SecureTransport conditions do not enforce encryption at rest.

API Gateway provides a managed HTTPS endpoint, Lambda processes each badge event without maintaining servers, and DynamoDB stores the results durably across Availability Zones for subsequent analysis.
Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves eligible objects between access tiers as access changes, avoiding manual access-pattern predictions.
A lifecycle AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload rule removes unused multipart parts that otherwise continue to incur storage charges.

Route internet egress through Network Firewall and enforce an allowlist of approved domains with stateful domain rules. Route both traffic directions consistently through the firewall and use NAT where needed.
Inspector detects EC2 software vulnerabilities; Systems Manager Patch Manager applies updates on a schedule. Scanning and patching are separate functions.

AWS Snowball is a physical data transport solution that helps customers transfer large amounts of data into and out of AWS. It addresses challenges associated with large-scale data transfers, particularly when network constraints, transfer times, or security concerns make online data transfer less practical. Historical-service limitation: Snowball Edge is available only to eligible existing customers since November 7, 2025; new customers need a current physical-transfer or online-transfer alternative.
Aurora Global Database maintains secondary clusters in other Regions through dedicated replication, enabling rapid recovery if the primary Region fails.

A Lake Formation blueprint ingests Aurora data into the S3 lake using Glue. Lake Formation enforces column permissions when QuickSight queries through Athena; S3 bucket policies cannot restrict individual table columns.
Aurora Global Database provides cross-Region replication with typically low lag and supports managed promotion of a secondary cluster during regional recovery.

The SQS Extended Client Library stores large message payloads in S3 and sends an S3 reference through SQS, supporting the required 50 MB payloads with limited application changes. The application's 256 KB limit in the question is not the current SQS service payload quota.
A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment provides a synchronous standby and automatic failover; the standby does not serve reporting queries.
A separate read replica offloads reporting queries from the writer and can reside in another Availability Zone.
RDS MySQL Multi-AZ provides a standby and failover while General Purpose SSD avoids the cost of unnecessary provisioned IOPS. Validate that baseline storage performance meets the workload.
S3 stores static files durably and CloudFront caches them near users.
FSx for Windows File Server provides a shared SMB file system for server-side files used by multiple Windows instances.
A Kinesis partition key based on payment ID places related records in the same shard, preserving their order; consumers must process each key in order.
An SQS FIFO message group based on payment ID serializes related messages while allowing different payments to be processed in parallel.
SNS server-side encryption with a customer managed KMS key protects message data at rest and gives control over key use.
SQS SSE-KMS protects queued message data at rest. A queue policy that denies aws:SecureTransport=false enforces TLS in transit.

API Gateway usage plans and API keys are the intended exam answer for separating subscribed clients with the least operational overhead among these choices. Caching/throttling alone and WAF do not implement subscription access, and DynamoDB fine-grained IAM would require a more complex authorization path.

choices.solution: Configure an NLB in each of three AWS Regions with supported UDP relay targets inside its VPC. Have the relays forward traffic over private connections to the on-premises application servers. Register the NLBs with Global Accelerator and point a CNAME to the accelerator DNS name.
choices.explanation: Global Accelerator and Regional NLBs support UDP routing, but an NLB UDP target cannot be an on-premises IP outside its VPC. Enable EBS encryption by default in the target Region and select the customer managed key before creating the managed node group.

choices.explanation: Authorize the managed node group's Auto Scaling service-linked role to use the KMS key, including grant creation. Attaching a KMS policy only to the EKS cluster role is insufficient for encrypted node volumes.

Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks can run custom audit work during launch or termination, but they pause the lifecycle transition until completion or timeout. Use EventBridge notifications when pausing is unacceptable.
Security-group references restrict HTTPS to traffic from the load balancer and MySQL to traffic from the web tier, instead of opening database ports to arbitrary hosts.

choices.solution: Grant the deployment engineer only the required CloudFormation stack actions and narrowly scoped iam:PassRole permission for the stack's service role.
choices.explanation: Give the deployment identity only the required CloudFormation stack actions and narrowly scoped iam:PassRole permission.

choices.solution: Create a CloudFormation service role with only the permissions needed for the stack's resources, and specify that role when launching the stack.
choices.explanation: Use a CloudFormation service role with only the permissions needed to create stack resources. CloudFormation assumes this role instead of requiring broad permissions on the deployment user.
DynamoDB stores sessions centrally so requests can reach any application instance without losing session state.
ElastiCache for Redis provides a shared low-latency session store; replication and Multi-AZ failover improve availability.
Public HTTPS access reaches the web tier, while a security-group reference permits MySQL access only from the web servers.
An EventBridge schedule launches an ECS Fargate task without managing a scheduler or worker hosts. Fargate supports long-running container jobs beyond the Lambda execution timeout.

Transferring 600 TB of data over a 100 Mbps connection would take a very long time. AWS Snowball Edge devices allow for offline data transfer, and you can transfer the data to the devices at your location before shipping them to AWS. This way, you are not constrained by the upload speed during the 2-week period. Historical-service limitation: Snowball Edge is available only to eligible existing customers since November 7, 2025; new customers need a current physical-transfer or online-transfer alternative.
Kinesis Data Streams retains data for 24 hours by default. Increase retention beyond the every-other-day consumer interval, with recovery margin, so records are not expired before consumption.
Target tracking adjusts application instance capacity to maintain the chosen utilization metric.
Scheduled scaling sets capacity to zero when the application is not needed and restores it before work resumes.
The web-server security group permits inbound HTTPS on port 443 from the internet.
The database security group permits MySQL on port 3306 only from the web-server security group.

choices.solution: Use AWS Global Accelerator with an NLB endpoint in each of two Regions. Run the processing application as an ECS service on Fargate and register the tasks in each NLB's UDP target group.

choices.explanation: the business system already writes CSVs to a network share. S3 File Gateway exposes an SMB/NFS share, but files written there are asynchronously uploaded into S3, so the application can keep behaving like it is writing to a normal file share.
CloudFront caches static content at edge locations, reducing latency and web-server load.
An RDS read replica offloads read-only queries from the primary database; route eligible queries to it explicitly.

Compute Savings Plans cover both eligible EC2 and Lambda usage. Configure Lambda VPC access to the private subnets so it can reach the EC2 instances directly; a public subnet does not give Lambda a public IP.

choices.solution: In each member account, enable EBS encryption by default in ap-southeast-2 and select a default KMS key.
choices.explanation: Enable EBS encryption by default in ap-southeast-2 in each member account and choose a default KMS key.

choices.explanation: An SCP denies unencrypted CreateVolume requests in member accounts. Add appropriate RunInstances protections where needed; an SCP does not affect the management account.

420.question: A company wants to use an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB cluster to simplify time-consuming database administrative tasks for production database workloads. The company wants to ensure that its database is highly available and will provide automatic failover support in most scenarios in less than 40 seconds. The company wants to offload reads off of the primary instance and keep costs as low as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

choices.explanation: Transfer Family provides a managed SFTP endpoint with EFS storage. An internet-facing VPC-hosted endpoint uses Elastic IPs and security groups to limit clients to trusted source addresses.
An identity-based IAM policy can be attached to a role and applies to sessions that assume it.
An identity-based IAM policy can be attached to an IAM group and supplies permissions to users in the group.

S3 object-created notifications invoke Lambda to convert each uploaded CSV into an image without waiting for a polling schedule.
Use prefix or tag filters to archive the CSV files and expire images after 30 days. Glacier Flexible Retrieval is suitable when training and audits are planned ahead.

434.question: A company hosts its application in the AWS Cloud. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer in an Auto Scaling group and with an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company wants to ensure the application can be made available in another AWS Region with minimal downtime. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of downtime?

This is a cost-effective solution for shipping large amounts of data to AWS. Snowball Edge devices are designed for efficient data transfer, and they can handle the 20 TB database. AWS DMS is a managed service for migrating databases to AWS, and AWS SCT can assist in converting the database schema. Using these tools in combination allows for a smooth migration process. Historical-service limitation: Snowball Edge is available only to eligible existing customers since November 7, 2025; new customers need a current physical-transfer or online-transfer alternative.

choices.solution: Order a 1 Gbps dedicated AWS Direct Connect connection to establish a connection with the data center. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with replication of ongoing changes.

choices.explanation: Share a manual encrypted RDS snapshot and its customer managed KMS key with the auditor's account. The auditor copies the snapshot using a key it controls and restores an independent database. Snapshots encrypted with the default AWS managed RDS key cannot be shared directly.

choices.solution: Use AWS Transit Gateway to add a transit gateway and connect a second VPC with the first VPC. Update the routes of the transit gateway and VPCs. Create new resources in the subnets of the second VPC.

440.question: A company used an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance during application testing. Before terminating the DB instance at the end of the test cycle, a solutions architect created two backups. The solutions architect created the first backup by using the mysqldump utility to create a database dump. The solutions architect created the second backup by enabling the final DB snapshot option on RDS termination. choices.explanation: A compatible RDS for MySQL snapshot can be migrated to a new Aurora MySQL cluster.

RDS Custom for Oracle provides managed automation while allowing supported host and database customization needed for third-party features.
Separate the application tiers into private subnets across two Availability Zones and scale the web and application tiers independently.

Lambda runs the API business logic without provisioning or patching application servers.
RDS provides a managed relational database, reducing database infrastructure administration.
Global Accelerator supplies stable entry IPs and optimized routing to NLB endpoints. NLB supports both TCP and UDP and integrates with the application Auto Scaling group.
A Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group provides redundant instances and automatic replacement, while an ALB routes requests only to healthy application targets.
Savings Plans and reservation discount sharing are controlled through the management account's billing preferences and apply to eligible usage under consolidated billing.
An API Gateway VPC link connects the public API integration to a private load balancer serving ECS tasks, leaving the application infrastructure private.

DynamoDB point-in-time recovery enables managed exports of a selected table state to S3 without consuming table read capacity. An export is a point-in-time operation, not continuous streaming.
An SQS standard queue provides durable at-least-once delivery with low operational overhead. The Lambda execution role requires queue permissions and kms:Decrypt for the encrypted messages.
Transcribe converts speech in supported languages to text; it does not support every language.
Translate converts supported source-language text into English.
Comprehend evaluates the English text for sentiment and produces results that can be aggregated into reports.

S3 File Gateway exposes NFS or SMB file shares backed by S3 with a local cache.
Volume Gateway exposes iSCSI block volumes and stores managed backups in AWS.
An S3 gateway endpoint installs a service-prefix route in the private subnet's route table, allowing S3 traffic to bypass a NAT gateway.

A Direct Connect Partner can provision a hosted connection at supported sub-1-Gbps bandwidth such as 200 Mbps; dedicated connections have different capacity options.
DataSync copies SMB file data to FSx for Windows File Server and can preserve Windows ACLs when the required permissions are configured.
Historically, a Snowcone device could run a DataSync agent for an online SMB transfer that preserves ACLs. This is an older alternative; use a supported DataSync agent host for new deployments.

EFS provides one shared image repository that all application instances can mount concurrently.
A Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group replaces failed instances and scales the website behind an ALB; CloudFront improves delivery and reduces origin load.

A customer-created cross-account role provides temporary read-only permissions for EC2 and CloudWatch. Use an external ID in the trust policy for a third-party service to prevent the confused-deputy problem.

choices.solution: Create the interface VPC endpoints required for private node access to AWS services, including ECR and EC2, plus an S3 gateway endpoint for image layers. Verify private Kubernetes API endpoint DNS and security-group access.

Redshift supports scheduled analytical workloads and can pause eligible provisioned clusters between runs to reduce compute costs.

choices.solution: In every business account, create an IAM role named BU_ROLE with a policy that gives the role access to the DynamoDB table and a trust policy to trust a specific role in the inventory application account. The Kubernetes Metrics Server supplies CPU and memory metrics to the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, which changes pod replica counts. Custom metrics require a separate metrics adapter.
Cluster Autoscaler changes EC2 node-group capacity when pods cannot be scheduled or nodes are underutilized.

Transfer Family provides a managed FTP endpoint backed by S3. Object-created events invoke Lambda immediately; the stated 3-8 minute processing duration fits Lambda's 15-minute timeout. Delete the input only after successful, idempotent processing.

choices.solution: Store logs in S3 Standard initially. Transition them to S3 Standard-IA after 30 days and expire them after 90 days. Do not transition them to Glacier at the same time they expire.

RDS Multi-AZ provides a standby and failover, while separate read replicas offload analytical queries. The standby in a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment does not serve read traffic.
