This is designed for low RPO/RTO DR while avoiding the cost of a continuously running warm standby. Nightly backups cannot meet an RPO of 30 seconds.

540.question: A company has an on-premises server that uses an Oracle database to process and store customer information. The company wants to use an AWS database service to achieve higher availability and to improve application performance. The company also wants to offload reporting from its primary database system. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

choices.solution: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle with a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Create an Oracle read replica and direct reporting queries to that replica.
choices.explanation: RDS for Oracle Multi-AZ provides failover, and a separate Oracle read replica offloads reporting. Oracle does not use the RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster reader architecture; Oracle read replicas require the supported Enterprise Edition and Active Data Guard licensing.
API Gateway and Lambda implement the API, while DynamoDB stores user data without database server management.
A Cognito user pool provides user registration and authentication.
Amplify Hosting publishes the static frontend through CloudFront for scalable global delivery.

543.question: A company runs Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS accounts that are individually billed. The company recently purchased a Savings Plan. Because of changes in the company's business requirements, the company has decommissioned a large number of EC2 instances. The company wants to use its Savings Plan discounts on its other AWS accounts. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

choices.explanation: The management account controls Savings Plans discount sharing through billing preferences.
Bringing the accounts into one organization enables consolidated billing and sharing of eligible Savings Plans discounts.
Grant the Lambda execution role kms:Decrypt on the specific key used for encrypted values.
The KMS key policy must also permit the execution role directly or enable IAM delegation; IAM permission alone cannot override a restrictive key policy.

choices.solution: Use S3 Standard initially. Configure an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition reports to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days, explicitly allowing objects smaller than 128 KB.
choices.explanation: Glacier Flexible Retrieval standard restores typically complete within 3-5 hours, while Deep Archive cannot meet a six-hour requirement. The 50 KB reports need an explicit lifecycle size-filter or transition-default override because current lifecycle defaults block transitions below 128 KB. Assess per-object request and metadata overhead for small files.

A Compute Savings Plan provides flexibility across EC2 instance families, sizes, Regions, operating systems, and compute services while still providing a commitment discount. A 1-year No Upfront plan best matches the need to change instance type and family every few months.
An SQS interface endpoint provides private connectivity. Allow HTTPS from application instances in the endpoint security group and restrict access through IAM and endpoint policies.
EMR runs distributed processing for the S3 dataset and can join it with Redshift-derived data through supported connectors and permissions.
Choose the user-defined resource tag that identifies the product line for cost allocation.
Activate the tag in the Organizations management account so consolidated billing can attribute eligible resource costs by product line.
Associate the DynamoDB gateway endpoint with the relevant route tables so the service prefix-list route is installed.
A DynamoDB gateway endpoint provides access from the VPC without an internet gateway or NAT gateway.
EventBridge publishes matched-event, invocation, and failed-invocation metrics in the AWS/Events CloudWatch namespace, distinguishing rule matching from target delivery failures.

Import the certificate and private key issued by the third-party CA into ACM in the API's Region, then associate it with the Regional custom domain. Imported certificates need externally managed renewal.

Four On-Demand instances, with two in each of two Availability Zones, preserve the required two running instances if one entire zone fails. Two instances total would leave only one after a zone failure.

583.question: A company has 5 PB of archived data on physical tapes. The company needs to preserve the data on the tapes for another 10 years for compliance purposes. The company wants to migrate to AWS in the next 6 months. The data center that stores the tapes has a 1 Gbps uplink internet connectivity. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? [Historical question: Tape Gateway on Snowball Edge is no longer available; the listed offline option cannot be deployed today.]

choices.explanation: This is the historical offline-transfer answer, but Tape Gateway on Snowball Edge was discontinued in March 2024. None of the listed choices currently solves the stated 5 PB migration in six months over a 1 Gbps link: transferring 5 PB continuously would take roughly 463 days before overhead. Use a current physical-transfer service or increase network capacity.
An AWS account can belong to only one organization at a time. Leave the previous organization before accepting the new organization's invitation.
S3 File Gateway exposes an on-premises file share backed by S3 for collecting the CSV files.
A Glue crawler discovers the CSV schema and creates Data Catalog tables.
Athena queries the CSV data in S3 using the cataloged schema without provisioning database servers.
The customer provides the site power and network connectivity needed by Outposts.
The customer controls physical security and access to the data center housing the racks.
The customer plans sufficient application capacity to tolerate server failures and maintenance; AWS manages the Outposts hardware itself.
choices.solution: Providing extrafficapacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events

choices.explanation: A compatible Aurora PostgreSQL read replica follows the RDS PostgreSQL source until cutover. Stop source writes, wait for replication to catch up, and promote the replica into an independent cluster; this minimizes data loss and downtime.

With only a 500 Mbps uplink bandwidth shared among other on-premises applications, transferring 10 PB of data over the internet would be impractical and time-consuming. AWS Snowball provides a physical device that can be shipped to the company to facilitate faster initial data transfer. Historical-service limitation: Snowball Edge is available only to eligible existing customers since November 7, 2025; new customers need a current physical-transfer or online-transfer alternative.

608.question: A company has an application that serves clients that are deployed in more than 20,000 retail storefront locations around the world. The application consists of backend web services that are exposed over HTTPS on port 443. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The retail locations communicate with the web application over the public internet. The company allows each retail location to register the IP address that the retail location has been allocated by its local ISP. The company's security team recommends to increase the security of the application endpoint by restricting access to only the IP addresses registered by the retail locations. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

choices.solution: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB. Use IP-set rules to allow only registered retail-location IP addresses and update the sets as registrations change. Split the addresses across multiple IP sets as required by quotas.
choices.explanation: WAF IP-set rules filter HTTP requests at the ALB. More than 20,000 addresses require multiple IP sets under the standard per-set quota; configure the web ACL to block requests that match none of the approved sets.

choices.solution: Deploy AWS Firewall Manager to manage the ALB. Configure firewall rules to restrict traffic to the ALB. Modify the firewall rules to include the registered IP addresses.

choices.explanation: EFS provides managed shared NFS storage that multiple Linux EC2 instances can mount concurrently.
An on-premises DataSync agent transfers the existing NFS data to EFS without writing a custom migration tool.
DynamoDB capacity autoscaling adjusts provisioned read and write capacity as demand changes; on-demand capacity is another option for unpredictable demand.
S3 hosts the static content and CloudFront caches it globally without operating web servers.
RDS Blue/Green Deployments creates a separate synchronized environment for testing supported production changes, then switches over with reduced downtime. Confirm engine and feature support.

choices.solution: Create an SNS subscription that sends the event to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Configure the SQS queue to trigger a Lambda function.
choices.explanation: An SNS subscription to SQS durably buffers the notifications. A Lambda event source mapping polls SQS and retries failures, decoupling publication from processing.
Lambda scales application code with request-driven invocations without maintaining compute hosts.
DynamoDB provides a managed key-value database; use on-demand capacity for unpredictable traffic.
A presigned S3 URL grants temporary access to a specific operation without distributing AWS credentials. Its effective permissions and expiry are bounded by the signing identity and credentials.

639.question: A company is building a new furniture inventory application. The company has deployed the application on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in their VPC. A solutions architect has observed that incoming traffic seems to favor one EC2 instance, resulting in latency for some requests. What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

choices.explanation: Authorize the Lambda execution role in the KMS key policy to decrypt with the key.

choices.solution: Create a Lambda execution role with kms:Decrypt on the specific KMS key and s3:GetObject on the required objects, and attach the role to the function.
choices.explanation: Attach an execution role with kms:Decrypt and the required S3 read permissions to the function.

choices.solution: Enable Cost and Usage Reports for member accounts. Deliver the reports to Amazon Kinesis. Use Amazon QuickSight for analysis.
Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena for analysis.
Request an ACM public certificate with example.com and *.example.com as subject alternative names, and associate it with the ALB HTTPS listener.
choices.explanation: Request an ACM public certificate covering example.com and *.example.com. A wildcard does not cover the apex domain or multiple subdomain levels.

DNS validation proves domain ownership and supports automated renewal while the validation records and certificate usage remain valid. ACM also supports email validation for public wildcard certificates.

A KMS external key store keeps key material and cryptographic operations in an external key manager while retaining compatible KMS integrations. The customer is responsible for external availability and latency.

choices.solution: Migrate to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server. Use read replicas for reporting purposes

choices.explanation: S3 Standard-IA keeps multi-AZ durability for the infrequently accessed period. Glacier Instant Retrieval meets the instant-access requirement after 360 days, and Deep Archive is the lowest-cost tier that still supports retrieval within 12 hours for long-term audit data.

A transient EMR cluster avoids paying for idle capacity between six-hour daily runs. Keep primary and core nodes on On-Demand instances so data is not lost, and use Spot only for replaceable task nodes.

CloudTrail events can trigger EventBridge, which invokes Lambda immediately after resource creation. Lambda can look up the creator's cost center in RDS and apply the correct tag. SCPs cannot dynamically derive tag values from a database.

Use CloudFront + S3 for highly available static content, an ALB + ECS Fargate for the PHP application, and Multi-AZ ElastiCache for Redis sessions. This removes the single EC2/Redis failure point and uses managed services.
An ALB provides a public HTTP endpoint and supports sticky sessions when configured on the target group.
A WAF web ACL associated with the ALB filters application-layer threats before requests reach the instances.
S3 Standard-IA is highly available and cost-effective for objects read only once or twice per year. EBS/EFS require servers or file-system capacity, and S3 Standard costs more for infrequent access.
A customer-managed VPC prefix list centralizes the office CIDRs. Sharing it through AWS RAM lets security groups in multiple accounts reference the same list, so a CIDR change is made once.
A cluster placement group places compute instances close together within one Availability Zone to reduce inter-instance network latency.
FSx for NetApp ONTAP provides shared NFS and SMB access to the same storage, meeting the multiprotocol requirement.

A Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device avoids consuming the already 90%-utilized VPN and is designed for secure offline transfer of tens of terabytes within a migration window like this. Historical-service limitation: Snowball Edge is available only to eligible existing customers since November 7, 2025; new customers need a current physical-transfer or online-transfer alternative.
Scheduled scaling launches instances before the predictable peak, giving initialization time and avoiding a delay while reactive policies detect traffic.
RDS Proxy pools application connections and reduces database connection overhead during bursts. It does not independently scale database compute or solve query bottlenecks.

Delete nonessential snapshots and use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to automate snapshot creation and retention. EBS volumes cannot simply be shrunk with Elastic Volumes, and manual cleanup has more operational overhead.

The ECS task role supplies application AWS permissions; the task execution role is used by ECS to launch tasks. Restrict S3 authorization to the task role and RDS network access to the tasks' security group. An RDS API interface endpoint does not provide private database SQL connectivity.
choices.solution: Restrict S3 bucket access to the ECS application task role. Place the RDS database in private subnets and allow MySQL traffic only from the ECS tasks' security group. Give tasks only the required S3 and database credentials or IAM permissions.

choices.explanation: The workload has rare, abrupt CPU spikes. Burstable instances in unlimited mode can absorb short spikes cost-effectively, and request-based scaling reacts automatically to actual demand. Scheduled scaling cannot predict irregular twice-monthly events.
CloudFormation defines reproducible infrastructure deployments. Config records supported resource configuration history and evaluates compliance rules to audit changes.
RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ provides database failover without changing the application to a different database engine.
An ALB and an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones provide redundant application instances and automatic replacement.

S3 interface endpoints are reachable from on-premises networks over Direct Connect. Gateway endpoints cannot be used from on premises; ensure private routing, DNS resolution, and endpoint policies are configured.

An enforced tag policy validates values on supported tagged resources, but does not block all untagged creation. Pair it with request-tag conditions in an SCP for supported creation APIs to require the tag across accounts.
choices.solution: Use an enforced Organizations tag policy for approved application-name values and an SCP that denies supported resource-creation requests when the required application-name tag is missing or invalid.

choices.explanation: AWS Secrets Manager integrates with RDS and can rotate database credentials automatically on a schedule, avoiding custom Lambda scheduling or manual CLI changes.

Provisioned capacity fits the known request rate. Schedule capacity increases before each weekly test and reduce capacity to the supported minimum afterward. Year-long reserved capacity is poorly utilized by a workload running only four hours per week; compare actual on-demand prices for the workload.
AWS Cost Anomaly Detection is designed to identify unusual spend and send alerts to stakeholders. A zero-spend budget is for detecting any spend, not anomalies in an existing workload.
AWS Glue can crawl the S3 data to build metadata, and Athena can query the files directly in S3 without provisioning a cluster. This is the lowest-operational-overhead path for quick ad-hoc analysis.
An RDS read replica serves read-only queries separately from the writer; the application must direct eligible reads to it.
ElastiCache stores reusable query results to reduce database reads; configure cache invalidation and expiry to meet freshness requirements.

EBS Snapshot Lock prevents deletion of a locked snapshot without changing the storage administrator's IAM rights. Compliance mode enforces the retention period after any cooling-off interval; governance locks can be removed by authorized users.

VPC Flow Logs can publish to CloudWatch Logs, and Kinesis Data Firehose can deliver the log stream to OpenSearch Service with minimal custom processing. CloudTrail is not a destination for VPC Flow Logs.

For an infrequently used development cluster, a managed node group consisting only of Spot Instances is the most cost-effective choice while still letting EKS manage the nodes. Mixing in On-Demand capacity adds cost that the requirement does not justify.

A customer-managed KMS key gives the company control over key policies, enable/disable state, and rotation while keeping key management managed by AWS. SSE-S3 and AWS-managed keys do not provide the same control.
Object Lock requires versioning and prevents permanent deletion of protected backup versions during retention.
A default compliance retention period protects new backup versions for 30 days.
choices.solution: Configure a default Object Lock compliance-mode retention period of 30 days for new backup objects.

choices.explanation: Lifecycle expiration hides current objects with delete markers. Also configure noncurrent-version expiration and delete-marker cleanup for permanent removal after retention; deletion is asynchronous.
choices.solution: Configure S3 Lifecycle expiration after 30 days, noncurrent-version expiration for eligible unlocked versions, and expired delete-marker cleanup. Allow asynchronous deletion after retention expires.

choices.explanation: AWS DataSync supports S3 and EFS locations and can transfer only changed data. That avoids custom Lambda/EC2 synchronization logic and prevents unchanged destination files from being overwritten.
A customer-managed KMS key can encrypt EBS volumes and gives the company control over key rotation. AWS-owned keys are not customer-controlled, and imported key material adds operational overhead.

Use IAM conditions to prevent unencrypted volume creation and Config rules with Systems Manager Automation for detection and remediation. Existing EBS volumes cannot be encrypted in place; remediation creates an encrypted snapshot copy and replacement volume, then arranges a safe cutover.
An ALB and Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling group provide a resilient web tier while preserving the application runtime.
RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ provides a managed database standby and failover while retaining MySQL compatibility.

Local Zones extend an AWS Region to locations closer to users and can provide single-digit millisecond latency. The selected Local Zone must satisfy the regulation and support the needed services; placing compute in a Local Zone does not automatically remove all dependency on its parent Region.
